name: Deepa Shah
text: The 21-day Garbh Sanskar session with Geetha Ma’am was a blessing. It helped me bond with my baby during my second pregnancy, stay calm while managing my 5-year-old, and feel more balanced. Yog Nidra, candle meditation and breastfeeding guidance made a big difference. Truly grateful for Ma’am’s positive energy and support.

name: Noopur
text: Whatever you taught us during pregnancy was so helpful then, and it still is today. From the time Tiara started talking, she has been singing and chanting the whole Gayatri Mantra, just the way you used to teach us. She turned 3 this August and loves singing and dancing. I am truly enjoying motherhood. Thank you so much, Ma’am, for still remembering us.

name: Smita
text: Joining your classes was truly life changing for me. It transformed me mentally and physically. I discovered the power of gratitude, healthy food and discipline, and I learnt to connect with my baby even before birth. When everyone came to meet him, he was so calm and didn’t cry at all. Thank you for being my guru and guiding light.

name: Shreya
text: My husband convinced me to take the classes, and your aura is so positive that even online, I had a stress-free pregnancy. My little one now knows all the mantras I recited to him during pregnancy by heart, and has an amazing vocabulary. I have recommended the classes to many friends and they feel the same.

name: Nikki Bokadia
text: I did your entire pre-pregnancy and post-pregnancy course, and it helped me a lot throughout the journey. I conceived, my pregnancy went so smoothly and I had a normal delivery. I learnt so many things from you, and my child listened to everything you said in the course while in my womb. It made me feel so blessed to have such a divine child.
